capabilities.title: Open-source document signing platform: upload, place fields, request signatures
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Documenso: self-hosted DocuSign alternative with full signing workflow
capabilities.reason: Nexus is not a document signing platform. Documenso's core product is outside scope.

capabilities.title: Next.js App Router patterns at scale: multi-tenant, server actions, API routes
capabilities.sourceEvidence: The current 2026-07-27 README lists React Router v7, Hono, Prisma, Tailwind, shadcn/Radix, tRPC, and PDF tooling; it no longer identifies a Next.js 14 App Router architecture.
capabilities.reason: The inventoried upstream architecture claim is stale. Nexus keeps its existing Next.js protected-route and API-route conventions instead of treating a different current framework as App Router evidence.

capabilities.title: PDF rendering in browser: react-pdf, PDF.js for document preview
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Documenso: browser-side PDF rendering for signature placement
capabilities.reason: Rendering untrusted PDFs requires a maintained parser/runtime, content limits, sandboxing, and a document-retention contract. Nexus currently accepts operator-extracted text and will not add a partial binary parser.

capabilities.title: Email-triggered action workflow: link in email → authenticated action in web app
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Documenso: sign-document email flow with single-use token
capabilities.reason: Nexus does not send action emails; this workflow is outside scope.
